create_onnx_session: create an ONNX Runtime session with optimized CUDA and CoreML provider configuration
build_provider_config: build optimized ONNX execution provider config with CUDA and CoreML options
run_inference: run ONNX model inference using IO binding for GPU-accelerated sessions
preprocess_face: preprocess a face image crop into an ONNX input tensor normalized to [-1, 1]
enhance_face_onnx: enhance a single face in a frame using an ONNX face restoration model with affine warping and feathered blending
